name: capsule-platform
description: Secure infrastructure platform for agent-built small software

scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.test:py: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path .venv/Scripts/python.exe) { .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest services/control-plane/tests } else { python -m pytest services/control-plane/tests }"
scripts.db:migrate: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path .venv/Scripts/python.exe) { .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m alembic -c services/control-plane/alembic.ini upgrade head } else { python -m alembic -c services/control-plane/alembic.ini upgrade head }"
scripts.control-plane:dev: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path .venv/Scripts/python.exe) { .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn --app-dir services/control-plane/src main:app --port 8000 --reload } else { uvicorn --app-dir services/control-plane/src main:app --port 8000 --reload }"
